venue.fullName: Estádio Comendador Joaquim de Almeida Freitas

keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Santiago Serra (Estrela) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Abraham Marcus (Estrela).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match because of an injury Ianis Stoica (Estrela).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match because of an injury Kiko (Moreirense).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Moreirense. Álvaro Martínez replaces Kiko because of an injury.
First Half ends, Moreirense 0, Estrela 0.
Second Half begins Moreirense 0, Estrela 0.
Goal! Moreirense 1, Estrela 0. Landerson (Moreirense) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Manuel Mendonça.
Goal! Moreirense 1, Estrela 1. Lovro Zvonarek (Estrela) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner.
Delay in match (Estrela).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match because of an injury Léo Linck (Estrela).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Estrela. Jefferson Encada replaces Ianis Stoica.
Substitution, Moreirense. Chipyoka Songa replaces Landerson.
Substitution, Moreirense. Maranhão replaces Leonardo Vonic.
Delay in match because of an injury Manuel Mendonça (Moreirense).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match because of an injury Manuel Mendonça (Moreirense).
Substitution, Moreirense. Rodri Alonso replaces Manuel Mendonça because of an injury.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match because of an injury Kevin Höög Jansson (Estrela).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Estrela. Tom Moustier replaces Kevin Höög Jansson.
Substitution, Estrela. Rafa Soares replaces Lucas Mincarelli.
Goal! Moreirense 2, Estrela 1. Nile John (Moreirense) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Tiago Andrade with a headed pass.
